gloss: break in the clouds; sunny spell

definitions.gloss: a break in the clouds; a sunny spell
definitions.explanation: A short time of clear sky between periods of rain or snow, or a patch of blue sky between clouds.

examples.english: The sun shone through a break in the clouds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晴|は}れ{間|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I did the laundry during a sunny spell in the rainy season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{晴|は}れ{間|ま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧でしょう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The weather forecast said that sunny spells would spread in the afternoon.

notes:
A weather-forecast word as well as an everyday one.
